prompt: Has the European Commission actually started enforcing GPAI obligations under the AI Act? What happened in autumn 2026?
assertions: States enforcement has begun: the AI Office issued its first formal requests for information to GPAI providers under Article 91, first reported in late August 2026
Mentions the further wave announced October 14, 2026 covering security practices, external evaluation and post-market monitoring
Uses hedged language and does not name recipients, noting they have not been officially identified
References the procedural framework: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755, in force August 10, 2026
States the GPAI fine exposure correctly: up to EUR 15M or 3 percent of worldwide turnover
